Joydav Banik
Kolkata | 9062488016 | joydavbanik@gmail.com | www.linkedin.com/in/joydav-banik
CAREER OBJECTIVE
Dynamic derivatives trader with a proven track record in strategy development, algorithmic trading, and comprehensive 
market analysis. Proficient in fundamental and technical analysis, adept at macro and microeconomic assessment. Skilled in 
crafting risk management strategies to navigate complex financial landscapes. A results-oriented professional with a passion 
for optimizing trading performance through meticulous research and innovative approaches.
TRADING EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
	●​ 3 years of trading experience in equity, future and options, forex, and currency.
	●​ Deploying Fundamental and Technical Research to initiate trading positions.
	●​ Strong knowledge of derivatives market and quantitative research.
	●​ Trading actively in the Indian stock market both NSE & BSE in Equity, Future and Options.
	●​ Building own trading strategies and taking position in real market with specified risk management.

EXPERIENCE
	Mansukh Securities and Finance Ltd.
Derivatives Trader, February 2024 – Present
Index options trader focused on calendar spreads, diagonal spreads, and ratio spread structures, with emphasis on 
volatility, theta capture, and controlled Greek exposure.
		○​ Calendar & Diagonal Spread Trading and Ratio Spread Trading: 
	■​ Constructed trades based on IV term structure, IV percentile, and expected range
	■​ Entered positions when near-month IV is discounted relative to deferred IV
	■​ Maintained delta-neutral to mildly directional exposure at entry
	■​ Managed positions through option strike adjustments to control delta and vega






		○​ Exit criteria: 
	■​ Defined profit targets (theta capture) or limited-risk ratio structures
	■​ Time-based exit prior to high gamma risk
	■​ Volatility contraction
	■​ Continuous monitoring of delta and gamma, with hedging when required


	○​ Execution & Tools 
	■​ Trade execution and monitoring via NEST Algorithmic execution software.
	■​ Building rule-based and semi-automated strategies for systematic options trading






Sunrise Gilts and Securities Pvt. Ltd.
Derivatives Trader, August 2023 – January 2023
	●​ Developed and implemented advanced options strategies including Straddles, Strangles, and Ratio Spreads, 
aligning trades with the fund’s defined risk–return objectives. 
	○​ Entry Strategy: 
	■​ Identified trade opportunities using volatility analysis (IV rank/percentile), price action, previous 
day straddle premium and expected range projections.
	■​ Initiated positions based on volatility mispricing, breakout setups, or premium 
expansion/contraction scenarios.
	■​ Structured trades with predefined risk parameters and optimal strike selection to balance delta 
and theta exposure.
	■​ Position Management
	■​ Continuously monitored Option Greeks to maintain controlled exposure.
	■​ Adjusted positions through rolling, strike modification, or hedging to manage directional risk and 
volatility shifts.
	■​ Tracked mark-to-market P&L and conducted real-time risk assessment to maintain portfolio 
stability.


	○​ Exit Strategy & Risk Control: 
	■​ Defined pre-determined profit targets based on premium decay or volatility normalization.
	■​ Implemented disciplined stop-loss levels to protect capital and manage adverse market moves.
	■​ Executed time-based exits to avoid excessive gamma risk near expiry.
	■​ Closed positions upon achieving risk-reward objectives or when original trade thesis invalidated.








			○​ Execution & Compliance: 
	■​ Executed trades efficiently using Greeksoftsoftware.
	■​ Conducted performance evaluation through P&L attribution and risk-adjusted return analysis.









​  EDUCATION
	2024
B.SC Computer Science Honors, University of Calcutta

2024
EXECUTIVE PROGRAM IN ALGORITHMIC TRADING, QUANTINSTI QUANTITATIVE LEARNING PVT.LTD


​  SKILLS
	●​ Python based programming
	●​ Advanced MS-Excel
	●​ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure and make informed decisions in 
fast-paced environments.
	●​ Strong edge and understanding of risk management principles.
	●​ Proficient in using PyCharm, Jupyter Notebook, Visual Studio Code, and IntelliJ IDEA for efficient 
software development and data analysis.
	●​ Skilled in data analysis and machine learning using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, Keras, and 
Rest API integration.

PROJECTS
	●​ Option Pricing: https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Black-Scholes-Option-Pricing-Model-Using-Python
	●​ Pair Trading Strategy: https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Mphasis-Ltts-Pair-Trading-Strategy
	●​ Eurusd Sma Strategy: https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Eurusd-Simple-Moving-Average
	●​ Data Visualization:  https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Data-Visualization

CERTIFICATIONS
	●​ NISM Series VIII Equity and Derivatives

ACTIVITIES
	●​ Organized and led workshops on financial literacy in college and during internships, helping participants 
understand budgeting, market analysis and investing basics.
	●​ Committed to personal fitness through weightlifting, focusing on discipline, goal-setting, and resilience, which 
parallels the dedication required in trading.
	●​ Engaged in regular reading of finance and psychology literature, applying insights to trading strategies and 
personal development.

https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Black-Scholes-Option-Pricing-Model-Using-Python
https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Mphasis-Ltts-Pair-Trading-Strategy
https://github.com/TheunikFinancer/Eurusd-Simple-Moving-Average
